scope: Explicit optional color-key policy, matching alpha material, caller-supplied occurrence identity and selected-frame/skin metadata in the existing neutral adapter. No dispatch, native viewer, decoder, or Shared source changes.

hashConvention.sourceSha256Lf: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF/CR to LF normalization, without trimming.
hashConvention.declarationSha256Lf: SHA-256 of the exact Tree-sitter C# method-declaration span in LF-normalized source, including signature and body, excluding preceding comments and following whitespace.

variables.I: Length of the optional caller-supplied source identity string.

callables.incrementalTime: O(I) JSON serialization and existing metadata validation for a constant number of metadata objects. Alpha selection and the additional post-PNG cancellation checkpoint are O(1). No additional geometry walk, skin decode, corpus lookup, or payload read is introduced.
callables.incrementalStorage: O(I) metadata strings/serialization storage retained or transient across a constant number of scene objects. Geometry remains O(F), selected skin decode and PNG construction retain their inherited costs. No source buffer is modified or newly retained by the metadata.
callables.disposition: Use existing SceneDocument.SourceIdentity and document/node extras. Never infer occurrence identity from the display label. Default to opaque pixels/material; opt-in keying pairs alpha-zero magenta pixels with a mask material. Preserve existing animation declines and source basis/units.

callables.incrementalTime: O(1) parameter forwarding. Existing selected-skin decode and PNG encoding are unchanged; no second decode or image comparison is added to production.
callables.incrementalStorage: No additional image buffer. Existing palette/index expansion and encoded image ownership remain unchanged.
callables.disposition: Pass the caller's explicit policy to the existing decoder instead of inheriting its hypothetical keyed default.

verification.sourceReview: Tree-sitter C# parsing of changed production and test files reports no syntax errors. Existing pinned Shared scene/export and SharpGLTF APIs reviewed. No build or tests were run by this implementation task.
verification.priorFrozenWindowsBaseline: 18 cases passed with zero skips: 11 pre-increment adapter cases plus 7 existing resolver cases. This is baseline evidence only.

limits: No production dispatch, native viewer, GUI workflow, or complete plan milestone is accepted by this increment.
Magenta transparency remains a caller-selected hypothesis, not an authenticated per-asset flag.
Multi-frame animation with authored sequence rates still declines; no duration or frame rate is invented.
This is an incremental source complexity review, not a measured throughput, allocation, or peak-memory improvement.
Cancellation retains existing synchronous unroll/decode boundaries; the added checkpoint observes cancellation after PNG creation.
